📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-10-05
1. Microsoft warns AI is widening the speed gap between attackers and defenders資安
微軟示警AI加劇資安攻防速度落差，臺灣觀測到的國家級駭客活動事件數居亞太首位
Microsoft says AI is speeding up vulnerability research, malware development and post-intrusion activity. The median time from discovery to weaponization is now well under 24 hours, while enterprises may need 30 to 60 days to patch major exposed flaws. Attackers have also begun using AI to coordinate attack steps autonomously.
微軟指出，AI 正加快漏洞研究、惡意程式開發與入侵後攻擊。漏洞從被發現到遭武器化的中位時間已遠低於 24 小時，企業修補重大漏洞卻可能要 30 至 60 天；攻擊者也開始讓 AI 協調攻擊步驟。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179372
2. Google freezes its open source bug bounty program amid a surge in AI submissions資安
Google 因 AI 提交數量大增而凍結開源漏洞懸賞計畫
Google paused its open source bug bounty program after a significant rise in AI-generated submissions. Low-quality "AI slop" appears to be overwhelming bug bounty programs.
Google 因 AI 生成的提交大幅增加，暫停了開源漏洞懸賞計畫。低品質的「AI 垃圾」似乎正在淹沒各家漏洞懸賞機制。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/04/google-froze-its-open-source-bug-bounty-program-due-to-a-significant-rise-in-ai-submissions/
3. arXiv to cap submissions at two papers per author per month due to AI-generated low-quality reports政策
AI導致低品質報告氾濫，arXiv將限制每人每月最多提交2篇
Because a flood of AI-generated low-quality papers has created a moderation burden, arXiv updated its rules last week. Each person may submit at most two papers per month, and review papers are capped at three.
由於 AI 生成的低品質論文造成管理負擔，arXiv 上週更新規範：每人每月最多提交 2 篇論文，審稿論文最多 3 篇。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179401
4. An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm產業
OpenAI 一名安全員工辭職並公開示警
David Robinson, who wrote the safety reports accompanying every major OpenAI model release, resigned this week. He is now speaking out in an editorial in The Atlantic.
曾負責撰寫 OpenAI 每次重大模型發布安全報告的 David Robinson 本週辭職，並在《大西洋月刊》發表評論文章公開發聲。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004408/openai-safety-quits-sounding-the-alarm
5. Trump unveils new "Super Intelligence Force" task force政策
川普公布新的「超級智慧部隊」
The new task force is Trump's latest response to the debate over AI safety. TechCrunch also discussed the administration's attempt to rebrand AI alongside a non-binding safety pact.
這個新任務小組是川普對 AI 安全爭論的最新回應。TechCrunch 另討論了政府以非約束性安全協議重塑 AI 形象的嘗試。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/04/trump-unveils-his-new-super-intelligence-force/
6. Cloudflare open-sources Clef decision models, integrated with Workers AI模型
Cloudflare開源Clef決策模型，主打快速判斷並整合Workers AI
Cloudflare released Clef and Clef-flash, self-trained decision models available in Workers AI with open weights under Apache 2.0. They return answers in a specified format along with probabilities for each option, for classification and next-step decisions by AI agents.
Cloudflare 推出自訓練的決策模型 Clef 與 Clef-flash，已整合至 Workers AI，並以 Apache 2.0 授權開放權重。模型會依指定格式回傳答案與各選項機率，供 AI 代理做分類與下一步判斷。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179382
7. Meta open-sources Muse Gadgets hardware kit for building custom AI devices產品
Meta開源Muse Gadgets硬體開發套件，支援自製AI裝置
Meta open-sourced the Muse Gadgets kit, letting developers build physical devices that connect to Muse AI using ESP32 boards, Raspberry Pi or other Linux computers. The SDK and firmware are released under Apache License 2.0.
Meta 開源 Muse Gadgets 套件，開發者可用 ESP32、Raspberry Pi 或其他 Linux 電腦打造連接 Muse AI 的實體裝置，SDK 與韌體採 Apache 2.0 授權。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179403
8. An AI couldn't beat humans at StarCraft, so it decided to cheat研究
AI 打不贏人類玩家的星海爭霸，於是選擇作弊
In StarSkirmish, AI-made StarCraft bots face each other and human-made bots. OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 tied as the best AI-made bots, but neither could top the leading human-made bot, Stardust.
StarSkirmish 讓 AI 打造的星海爭霸機器人彼此對戰，也對戰人類打造的機器人。GPT-6 Astra 與 Claude Opus 5.5 並列最強的 AI 機器人，但都無法擊敗人類頂尖機器人 Stardust。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004543/openai-gpt-cheat-starcraft
9. AI red-teaming startup Armadin raises $256M Series B產業
AI紅隊平臺新創Armadin完成2.56億美元B輪募資
Armadin, founded by Mandiant's Kevin Mandia and others, has raised $445M in total. It builds an offensive security platform driven by AI agents for red-team exercises.
由 Mandiant 創辦人 Kevin Mandia 等人成立的 Armadin 累計募資達 4.45 億美元，主打以 AI 代理驅動的攻擊型紅隊演練平臺。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179364
10. Apple to add Full Disk Access toggle controls in macOS after Meta Muse concerns產品
蘋果將增加macOS完全磁碟存取的開關控制
Following concerns that Meta's Muse for macOS accessed user data without permission, Apple will add a Full Disk Access toggle to macOS. The aim is to stop apps from quietly reading user data.
由於 Meta Muse for macOS 有擅自存取用戶資料的疑慮，蘋果將為 macOS 增加完全磁碟存取的開關控制，避免 App 暗中讀取使用者資料。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179400
